title: Lockheed VP Jim Ryder: the veil thinning as weakening magnetosphere

tellings.quote: this guy Jim Ryder, this VP of space systems there saying that the vent the fail sorry, the veil is thinning and that that is literally the magnetosphere of the earth which is weakening right now.

plain: Jim Ryder, a vice president of space systems at the aerospace and defence company Lockheed Martin, is said to have claimed that "the veil is thinning," the old idea that the barrier between our world and some other realm is wearing away, and that this is literally the Earth's magnetosphere, the magnetic field that shields the planet, which is weakening right now. A member of the show's crew, who is not named, repeats what he says Ryder said, which would turn a mystical phrase into a physical event.
